positive_negative_definition: Truth label within each concept; this is distinct from concept membership
matched_controls: Each content tuple has one true and one false claim sharing concept and wrapper template
split_control: No identical prompt, complete wrapper template, unordered numeric operand pair, negation entity-property pair, or valid bracket string across splits
number_domain: All splits sample without replacement from the same 0..63 operand domain
templates: Six held-out wrapper templates per concept per split; semantic sentence grammar is shared
answer_scoring: Teacher-forced full continuation likelihood for ' yes' versus ' no'; use identical textual candidates across tokenizers
alignment_position: Character span boundaries in each prompt and final prompt-token position; never compare token IDs across models
statistical_unit: Shared wrapper template across all concepts: 6 clusters per split; paired comparisons keep matched prompts and all concepts together
grouping_correction: Before results, replaced concept x wrapper grouping with wrapper-only grouping to avoid pseudoreplication; prompts, answers, seeds and split memberships unchanged
confidence_interval: 95% equal-cluster-weighted percentile bootstrap, exploratory with few semantically distinct task grammars
randomization: Paired method-label swaps/sign flips at cluster level; exact for <=16 clusters, Monte Carlo +1 correction otherwise
multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values for neuron-level families
licensing: Generated synthetic text and code are project-authored; no external corpus copied
limitations: Synthetic entity/property names in negation are not natural language semantics
Negation is solvable by property equality and uses adjacent numeric property names
Invalid syntax replaces a closing bracket with an opening bracket, allowing a count-only shortcut
Six shared wrappers do not imply six independent semantic grammars
Arithmetic false claims differ by one, allowing modular/parity shortcuts
Comparison changes the greater/less relation token within each pair
Natural-language top-activation atlas requires separately sourced licensed text
Truth contrast alone is not a test of monosemanticity
D3/D4 results must never change candidates, thresholds, method weights, or dataset version in-place
